notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.89

• DuckMaps starts talking the moment you tap Go: the voice is ready when DuckMaps opens, and the first direction is prepared while you look at the route.
• DuckMaps has animations: sheets slide up, the turn banner drops in, the pin drops onto the place, your dot pulses, and the route draws itself.
• Microphone in other apps: WhatsApp voice messages and calls should hear you now. DuckOS turns off the phone maker's sound effects on the microphone, which left those recordings silent. Settings > Sound > Microphone can turn them back on.
• Passkeys in apps like Discord: "Another phone or tablet" now always shows in Android's sign-in sheet, and DuckOS stays a passkey provider even when another one is set.
• Settings > Apps > an app: permission switches move at once and no longer jump back while Android changes them.
